task1.title: Letter of complaint
task1.prompt:
You recently stayed at a hotel and were unhappy with your experience.

Write a letter to the hotel manager. In your letter:
- describe the problems you experienced
- explain how these problems affected your stay
- say what you would like the manager to do

Write at least 150 words.

task2.title: Working from home
task2.prompt:
Some people believe that working from home is more productive and better for employees, while others think it harms teamwork and career development.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Write at least 250 words.
